classification: post hoc exploratory directional evidence; existing posterior directions were already known
score: mean log2(DESeq2-normalized count + 1) across all 182 originally mapped OXPHOS genes
units: three paired differentiation blocks across two backgrounds
comparison: each day versus common controls, marginalizing the other mean and shared covariance; not a point-null Bayes factor
encompassing_prior: independent zero-centered normal mean priors; half-normal marginal residual SDs; LKJ(eta) correlation
bayes_factor: posterior odds / prior odds for the two normalized sign-truncated encompassing priors, with identical inherited nuisance priors
likelihood_sensitivity: all existing Student-t(4) baseline posterior sign summaries retained separately; no new Student-t quadrature fit

numerics.method: analytic conditional normal means; log-SD and linear-rho trapezoid quadrature for covariance
numerics.sd_upper: max(8 * residual_sd, 6 * maximum observed marginal SD)

reporting: retain all declared settings, block observations, score intervals and directional Bayes factors; no discovery threshold, selected best prior, point-null claim, equivalence threshold or independent confirmation
limitations: three blocks do not imply three independent donors
relative RNA score is not mitochondrial function
priors are sensitivity assumptions without external biological calibration
browser changes are exploratory and do not modify the archive
